question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**topic**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the third sentence, we can observe that the person is required to have interest in what the speaker is **talking about**.
 
• Topic : a matter dealt with in a text, discourse, or conversation; a subject.
 
 
• For eg.- Sleep deprivation became a frequent **topic** of conversation
 
 
 
• We will thus use the word 'topic' to fill in the blank 3.
 
• Hence, <span style="font-weight: 700;"&g
